tool_args.rationale: The pilot signatures and recalled mechanism support a coupled memory ODE, but the five paid rows leave genuine parameter-identifiability ambiguity. Acquire the additional trajectory batch before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows leave the four coupled parameters insufficiently identified for reliable confirmation.
The trajectory batch directly supplies the additional observations needed to identify the recalled memory mechanism.
The observed history gap and coupled transient lag favor a memory-dependent model.
